warnings: *** HALF THE PANEL IS SPARE, AND THAT IS THE DESIGN, NOT MISSING DATA. *** The LP board is an 8-way unit (ขนาด 8 ช่อง) with circuits 1-4 loaded - all four labelled แสงสว่าง และเต้ารับ, lighting and sockets combined - and circuits 5, 6, 7, 8 all printed ว่าง (spare). Every one of the four spares is recorded as its own element rather than omitted, because a blank way on a schedule is real information a take-off needs.

*** REVERSED AFTER READING E-02 - THE CIRCUIT MAPPING IS NOT MISSING AFTER ALL. *** This file first recorded that the four loaded ways carry identical descriptions (แสงสว่าง และเต้ารับ) and concluded the circuit-to-area mapping 'simply is not in this drawing set'. THAT WAS WRONG. E-02 (หน้า25) prints bare home-run circuit digits on both floor plans: 1 and 2 on ชั้นล่าง, 3 and 4 on ชั้นบน, verified at 8x against the riser beside the LP board. So the four loaded ways split two per floor. The earlier reading is recorded here rather than deleted, per the append-or-rewrite rule. What genuinely remains unstated is the finer split - which outlets sit on circuit 1 versus 2, and on 3 versus 4 - because the digits mark the home runs only.

PROTECTION IS A 45AT 2-POLE MAIN WITH 10 kA BREAKING CAPACITY PLUS A 30 mA ELCB IN SERIES, then 16AT breakers on each loaded way. Recorded as printed; note the main and the ELCB share the same 45AT-2P rating.

PATTERN CHOICE: a single-line diagram is not a plan, a section or a schedule. §0.9 forbids coining a new pattern and §1 maps a schematic diagram to side_profile, which is what house 07's remapped diagram files also use. Recorded as side_profile for that reason, not because it is an elevation.
